page_title: BET 2-2 CEL | Betis v Celta Vigo 10/11/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' That's the end of the match.
90+5' 2 - 2 Marc Bartra (Betis) scores from quite a difficult position as he leaps high to connect with a cross and powers his header inside the right post. Excellent finish.
90+4' Juanmi (Betis) goes into the book for bad language. His vulgar comments could have made it worse. Luckily for him, it's a yellow card.

90+3' What a big chance! Vitor Roque (Betis) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball a whisker wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Celta Vigo.
90+1' Romain Perraud (Betis) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
89' Jonathan Bamba (Celta Vigo) latches on to a pin-point through ball, but one of the defending players dispossess him. Brilliant defending.
87' Jonathan Bamba (Celta Vigo) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
86' Manuel Pellegrini has decided to substitute Abde Ezzalzouli and he is replaced by Chimy Avila (Betis).
86' The substitution is prepared. Cedric Bakambu (Betis) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Iker Losada.
84' The main referee, Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias, is apparently not going to tolerate any discussions. Natan (Betis) is given a yellow card for dissent.
83' 1 - 2 Anastasios Douvikas (Celta Vigo) receives a well-taken defence-splitting low pass inside the box and scores! His great effort makes its way into the bottom right corner of the net.
80' Jonathan Bamba (Celta Vigo) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Williot Swedberg.
80' Claudio Giraldez prepares a substitution. Iago Aspas is replaced by Williot Swedberg (Celta Vigo).
76' Jonathan Bamba (Celta Vigo) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
75' Pablo Fornals goes off the pitch and Juanmi (Betis) comes on.
74' Iker Losada (Betis) takes the corner and sends it into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and makes a good clearance.
74' OFF THE BAR! Iker Losada (Betis) unleashes a thunderous effort from the edge of the box and the ball crashes off the woodwork. What a strike that was!

72' Celta Vigo slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
71' Looks like Vitor Roque (Betis) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
69' Vitor Roque (Betis) latches on to a through ball inside the box, but one of the defenders steps in with a timely interception. It could have been a great chance otherwise.
67' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Borja Iglesias leaves the pitch and Anastasios Douvikas (Celta Vigo) comes on.
66' The linesman raises his flag. Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) is adjudged offside.
64' Jonathan Bamba (Celta Vigo) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.

60' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Betis are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
57' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Oscar Mingueza departs the field of play to be replaced by Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo).
55' Manuel Pellegrini has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Giovani Lo Celso (Betis) replacing Johnny Cardoso.
55' Diego Llorente comes off the pitch to be replaced by Marc Bartra (Betis).
53' Vitor Roque (Betis) makes a run into the box in an attempt to get onto a long through ball, but one of the opponents comes up with a vital clearance.

52' Iker Losada (Betis) beats an opponent and drives towards the edge of the penalty area. He steadies himself and hits a tremendous shot that flashes a whisker past the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Celta Vigo.
49' A lofted pass finds Iago Aspas (Celta Vigo) free in the box, but his first-time effort sails high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Betis will have a goal kick.
49' Johnny Cardoso (Betis) brings down his opponent with a very late tackle.
46' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Ilaix Moriba (Celta Vigo) comes onto the pitch so that Mihailo Ristic can be given a rest.
46' Here is a change. Hugo Sotelo is going off and Claudio Giraldez gives the last tactical orders to Javier Manquillo (Celta Vigo).
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+3' Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+2' Wonderful movement by Celta Vigo. The players are holding possession, mostly exchanging one-touch passes. They control the pace of the game now.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
43' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) misses a rebound from the penalty spot. The ball flies just a few inches over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Celta Vigo will have a goal kick.
43' Vitor Roque (Betis) gets to the rebound inside the box and shoots to the middle of the goal, but his sidefooter is blocked by an alert Vicente Guaita. What a save!
43' Pablo Fornals (Betis) crosses into the box from near the side line, but he doesn't connect as he wanted and it's cleared by the well-organized defence.
40' 1 - 1 Vitor Roque (Betis) changes the scoreline after getting on the end of a brilliant pass and firing a precise shot that goes inside the right post!
39' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) gets a shot away from distance, but wasn't really set to take it and fires high and wide. The ball goes out of play and Celta Vigo will have a goal kick.
38' Iker Losada (Betis) did his best to latch onto a through ball, but it was too strong. The ball goes out of play and Celta Vigo will have a goal kick.
35' Johnny Cardoso (Betis) is arguing with the referee and is given a caution.
34' A pass by Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end. The ball goes out of play and Celta Vigo will have a goal kick.
32' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
31' The ball is cleared after Jonathan Bamba (Celta Vigo) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
29' Pablo Fornals (Betis) tries to find Vitor Roque, but he puts too much power on the pass. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Celta Vigo.
28' This corner kick is taken with a short pass by Pablo Fornals (Betis).
28' Pablo Fornals (Betis) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked. Betis win a corner.
26' Betis seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.

23' Vitor Roque (Betis) wastes a huge opportunity! He receives a precise cross inside the penalty area and releases a quick shot that sails towards the middle of a goal. His effort, however, lacks power and the goalkeeper makes a comfortable save.
23' Vitor Roque (Betis) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the bottom left corner, but Vicente Guaita has it covered and makes a comfortable save.
22' Mihailo Ristic (Celta Vigo) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
21' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) did his best to latch on to a crossfield pass, but it was too long and it goes out of play. The ball is out of play. Celta Vigo will take a throw-in.
20' Betis are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
18' Jonathan Bamba (Celta Vigo) tries to latch onto a through ball, but it's too long.
16' Here comes the VAR verdict: Referee Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias signals that the goal stands! The Celta Vigo players celebrate.
15' Celebrations by Celta Vigo are cut short as the referee signals that the legality of the goal will be checked using the VAR. Hopefully this won’t take too long.
13' 0 - 1 Goal! Javier Rodriguez (Celta Vigo) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the right side of the goal. It's 0:1.
13' Handball by Youssouf Sabaly (Betis). A free kick to Celta Vigo.
12' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Marcos Alonso (Celta Vigo) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
10' Jonathan Bamba (Celta Vigo) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
9' Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias blows for a foul after Mihailo Ristic (Celta Vigo) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
7' Rui Silva displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
5' A long pass finds Sergi Altimira (Betis) unmarked, he looks up and hits a weak shot from mid-range which drifts well wide of the left post.

4' Celta Vigo slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
2' Celta Vigo decide to take a short pass from the free kick and the attacking effort continues.
2' Pablo Fornals (Betis) commits a rough foul. Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias stops the game and makes a call. Celta Vigo win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
1' Pablo Fornals (Betis) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and Betis will have the kick-off.
Miguel Angel Ortiz Arias is introduced as the referee for today's match.
